gate_decision: stage58 admits the Shadowsocks AEAD TCP Rust true dataplane row: the opt-in smoke decrypts the client initial target, validates AEAD salt/HKDF/chunk framing, returns an encrypted payload echo over a SO_MARKed TCP underlay with MPTCP status, and records a local benchmark; SS2022, Shadowsocks UDP, SIP003 plugin, ShadowsocksR, and shared transports remain blocked, so Shadowsocks protocol-wide admission and overall outbound/default switches remain closed
name: stage58-shadowsocks-aead-tcp-dataplane-gate

rows.area: Shadowsocks AEAD TCP protocol data plane
rows.boundary: this covers AEAD TCP only; it is not SS2022, UDP PacketConn, SIP003 plugin, SSR, or daemon default runtime ownership
rows.evidence: Stage 58 runs a local Shadowsocks AEAD echo server and Rust client over a real underlay socket, decrypts target stage58.example:443, validates AEAD client salt, HKDF-SHA1 subkey, encrypted chunk framing, and encrypted payload echo
rows.next_action: carry AEAD TCP evidence into Shadowsocks protocol matrix while continuing SS2022 and UDP gates

rows.boundary: MPTCP support is kernel dependent; the gate records fallback status instead of silently assuming it
rows.evidence: Stage 58 dials the Shadowsocks server through Rust magic_tcp_connect with SO_MARK=1234 and MPTCP requested, recording socket protocol, mark, and fallback status
rows.next_action: repeat equivalent underlay evidence for SS2022, Trojan, VMess, VLESS, and shared transports

rows.boundary: SS2022 is a distinct capability selected by cipher family and must not be marked complete by ordinary AEAD TCP
rows.evidence: Stage 15/18 carried SS2022 parser, PSK, replay, and framing contracts, but Stage 58 does not execute AEAD-2022 TCP/UDP or Shadowsocks UDP PacketConn true dataplane
rows.next_action: add SS2022 TCP/UDP and Shadowsocks UDP true dataplane gates with replay/packet evidence

rows.boundary: these layers are not exercised by AEAD TCP loopback
rows.evidence: SIP003 simple-obfs/v2ray-plugin and ShadowsocksR require plugin/shared transport or obfs + stream cipher + SSR protocol layering
rows.next_action: complete shared transport and SSR layering gates before protocol-wide Shadowsocks/SSR admission

rows.evidence: SOCKS5, HTTP CONNECT, and Shadowsocks AEAD TCP rows are admitted, but remaining Shadowsocks variants plus other protocols and shared transports are incomplete
rows.next_action: continue per-protocol rows and matched Go/Rust daemon benchmark before reopening default switch
